copy.titleEn: A SLOW WALK WITH THE BREEZE

title.en: A slow walk with the breeze

deck.en: Down the lane slowly, one hand on the cap.

intro.ko: 골목을 천천히 내려가다 바람에 캡 챙을 살짝 잡고 돌아보는 순간. 성글게 짠 번트 오렌지 폴로는 바람이 통하고, 넓은 크림 팬츠가 걸음마다 가볍게 흔들려요.
intro.en: Strolling down a lane, he turns back and holds his cap brim against the breeze. The open weave of a burnt-orange polo lets the air through, and wide cream trousers swing with every step.
intro.de: Langsam die Gasse hinunter, ein Blick zurück, eine Hand an der Cap gegen die Brise. Das offene Strickmuster des rostorangefarbenen Polos lässt Luft durch, die weite cremefarbene Hose schwingt bei jedem Schritt.

copy.pullQuoteEn: LET THE BREEZE DO THE STYLING.

tip.ko: 바람이 있는 날엔 캡 뒤 조절 끈을 한 칸 조여 두고, 통 넓은 팬츠는 밑단이 샌들 아래로 밟히지 않는 길이로 고르세요.
tip.en: On breezy days, tighten the cap's back strap a notch, and choose wide trousers in a length that won't catch under your sandals.
tip.de: An windigen Tagen den Verschluss der Cap eine Stufe enger stellen und die weite Hose so lang wählen, dass der Saum nicht unter die Sandalen gerät.

copy.refinements: Producer delivered titles only (ko/en/de). deck ko/de = producer title, en deck rewritten so it does not repeat the English article title; intro, pull and tip written from the editorial scene. Product how-to-wear = producer text except where noted by sourceHowToWear (production remark or missing verb).
